facts.statement: During the Spooktacular season, vampire and werewolf sides compete in a dance contest held for the Pumpkin King on the outskirts of Bone Marsh; the side with the most supporters wins and gets a piece of the Pumpkin King's special cake.
facts.quote: el lado que tenga la mayoría de los aficionados en su lado ganara el concurso

facts.statement: Prince Pumpkin settles the vampire vs. werewolf debate by judging a dance contest; the side with the scariest dance is crowned the scariest monster.
facts.quote: l'équipe qui fait la danse la plus effrayante sera couronné le monstre le plus effrayant

facts.statement: Players join by talking to Madame Zelda at Black Spore, who starts the quest and lets them choose a side; she is located near the Boneyard cemetery, just south of the Haunted Mines.
facts.quote: Visite Madame Zelda au Spore Noir pour commencer la quête et choisir ton côté préféré

facts.statement: After the quests, players attend the dance when an in-game announcement says it is starting, wearing their Vampire or Werewolf costume; the side with the most fans wins and the winning side receives a piece of cake from the Pumpkin Prince.
facts.quote: Le côté avec le plus des fans gagnera la compétition et recevra un morceau de gâteau par le Prince de Citrouille

article_summaries.title: Vampiros vs. Hombres Lobos (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post describing a Spooktacular season event in which vampire and werewolf sides compete in a dance contest for the Pumpkin King. Players take a mission from Madame Zelda in Shadowbrook to choose a side, then join the contest at Bone Marsh when the in-game announcement appears; the side with the most fans wins a piece of the Pumpkin King's special cake.

article_summaries.title: Des Vampires contre les Loups-Garous! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language freerealms.com news post announcing a vampire-versus-werewolf dance contest run by Prince Pumpkin. Players start the event by talking to Madame Zelda at Black Spore, pick a side, and then, when an in-game announcement says the dance is starting, go to the Boneyard cemetery wearing their vampire or werewolf costume; the side with more fans wins a piece of cake from the Pumpkin Prince. The post gives only a relative date ('7 months, 6 days ago' at the 2011-06-04 capture), so its exact posting date is unknown.
